entries.lesson: '…anyway / that's just how it is' with a habitual event (note 本來就會)
entries.english: Don't blame yourself — old phones slow down over time anyway. It's not because you installed that app.
entries.context: Comforting a friend who thinks an app ruined their phone
referenceAnswers: 你別自責啦，舊手機本來就會愈用愈慢，不是你裝那個 app 害的。
不用怪自己啦，手機用久了本來就會變慢，跟你裝那個 app 沒關係。

firstAttempt.answer: 不要怪自己，舊手機本來就會變得很慢，跟你安裝的app沒有關係

entries.lesson: put the burden of proof on the other side, with a 'not me' contrast
entries.targetExpression: 舉證責任在…（身上）／要…的是…，不是…
entries.english: You're the one claiming our service is slower than theirs, so you should be the one bringing the data, not asking me to disprove it.
entries.context: In a team meeting, pushing back on a colleague's claim
referenceAnswers: 這個說法是你提出來的啊，舉證責任在你身上，不在我，要拿出數據的是你，不是叫我去證明沒有。
欸，說我們服務比他們慢的人是你耶，所以要拿數據出來的是你，不是我。

firstAttempt.answer: 說我們服務比他們慢的人是你，所以要拿出證據的是你，不應該要我推翻它

entries.lesson: state the feeling first, then the reason; 'didn't even…' with verb copying
entries.english: I'm not upset with you. I'm just a bit disappointed — you didn't even tell me you were changing the plan.
entries.context: To a coworker who rewrote your part of the proposal
referenceAnswers: 我不是在生你的氣，只是有點失望，你連講都沒跟我講一聲就把計畫改掉了。
我沒有生氣啦，只是心裡有點不舒服，你要改計畫連問都沒問我一下。

firstAttempt.answer: 我不是對你不爽，我只是有點失望，你連說都沒跟我說要改計劃

entries.lesson: attach 'obviously/all along' to the given premise that explains the result
entries.english: Of course nobody replied — it's a long weekend, there's hardly anyone in the office.
entries.context: To a teammate who's annoyed that his email got no response
referenceAnswers: 連假本來就沒什麼人在辦公室啊，當然沒人回你
你別急啦，連假期間本來就沒人在上班，當然不會有人回信啊

firstAttempt.answer: 有人回覆才怪，剛有連假，幾乎沒人在上班

entries.lesson: 'didn't even do X' with the object right after 連, plus a 的是你 cleft to pin responsibility
entries.english: You're the one who wants to raise the price, so you should show the numbers — you haven't even asked one customer.
entries.context: Pushing back on a colleague in a product meeting, friendly but firm
referenceAnswers: 想漲價的是你耶，那要拿出數據的應該也是你吧。你連一個客戶都還沒問欸
要調價格的是你啊，所以要說服大家的當然是你。你連一個用戶都沒訪談過欸，先去問再說啦

firstAttempt.answer: 想要把價錢調高是你，所以要拿出數據的人也應該是你吧，你連一個客戶都沒問

entries.lesson: past narration: 了 attaches to the verb with a quantity, and 在+V marks the ongoing consequence without 了
entries.targetExpression: V 了一堆… ，現在就是在…
entries.english: Back then we skipped a ton of tests to ship early, and now we're stuck fixing bugs every single day.
entries.context: Venting to a teammate during a sprint retro
referenceAnswers: 我們當初為了趕上線省了一堆測試，現在就是在天天修bug。
之前為了提早上線少寫了一堆測試，結果現在每天都在修bug，根本修不完。

firstAttempt.answer: 我們當初為了早點部署，跳過了很多測驗，害我們現在每天都在修錯誤

entries.lesson: set up the expectation, then land the reversal
entries.english: We hired two more people to ship faster, but if anything the project slowed down — turns out nobody knew who owned what.
entries.context: Venting to a friend about your team
referenceAnswers: 本來多找兩個人是想快一點交出去，結果進度反而更慢，後來才發現根本沒人知道誰負責哪一塊。
我們本來想說多兩個人會比較快，結果專案反而拖更久，查了才知道大家都搞不清楚誰負責什麼。

firstAttempt.answer: 我們本來多請了兩個人，是為了早點上線，結果專案反而變慢了，後來發現我們都不清楚誰負責哪一塊

entries.lesson: state an inherent, unavoidable premise (with a concrete amount) to back up a counter-intuitive claim, plus 'on the contrary'
entries.english: Cutting the review time won't help — reading a big PR properly takes an hour anyway, so rushing it actually creates more bugs.
entries.context: To a colleague who wants to speed up code review
referenceAnswers: 砍 review 的時間沒用啦，好好看完一個大 PR 本來就要一個小時，趕著看反而會多出更多 bug 耶。
你把 review 時間壓短其實沒幫助，認真看一個大 PR 本來就要一小時，硬趕反而會漏掉東西，bug 更多啦。

firstAttempt.answer: 簡短審查時間不會有幫助，看大PR本來就需要一個小時的時間，很趕反而會造成更多bug

entries.lesson: isolate one sub-task and price it ('just X alone takes…'), then cap it with 'let alone'
entries.english: It's way more than a weekend project. Just setting up the test environment alone takes two days, let alone the actual migration.
entries.context: To a friend who thinks you can finish a side project over the weekend
referenceAnswers: 這哪是一個週末能搞定的，光是把測試環境架起來就要兩天，更不用說真正要搬的東西。
一個週末根本做不完啦，光架測試環境就兩天跑不掉，真正的搬移都還沒開始。

firstAttempt.answer: 這不是一個週末就可以完成的事情，光是做好測試環境就要兩天，更不用說migration本身

entries.lesson: scaling claim to evidence, with 就 in the second clause and 這種+評價 to dismiss a whole category
entries.english: The more unbelievable the theory, the more solid the data has to be. One anonymous post on Reddit is basically no evidence at all.
entries.context: Arguing with a friend who believes a conspiracy theory
referenceAnswers: 理論越離譜，資料就要越扎實啊。Reddit 上一篇匿名的貼文，這種根本不算證據。
說法越誇張，證據就得越有力。光是 Reddit 上一個匿名的人講的，這種根本沒什麼說服力啦。

firstAttempt.answer: 越誇張的說法，就需要越紮實的證據，Reddit上隨便一個po文根本不算什麼證據

entries.lesson: pin who has to prove it, using a 的是 cleft (keep 的 in both halves)
entries.targetExpression: 要拿出證據的是…／舉證責任在…身上
entries.english: You're the one claiming the new framework is faster, so you're the one who has to show the numbers — I don't have to prove it isn't.
entries.context: To a teammate in a design review, half-joking
referenceAnswers: 說新框架比較快的是你，那要拿出數據的也是你啊，不是我要證明它不快耶。
舉證責任在你身上啦，你說它比較快，那要拿出證據的就是你，不是我。

firstAttempt.answer: 說新框架比較快的人是你，所以要拿出數據也應該是你吧，而不是我需要否認

entries.lesson: set up an expectation first, then land the reversal (adverb goes after the subject, before the verb)
entries.targetExpression: 本來想說／本來以為…，結果／沒想到…反而…
entries.english: We added two more engineers thinking the release would speed up, but if anything it slowed everything down.
entries.context: Complaining to a friend about your software team
referenceAnswers: 我們本來想說多加兩個工程師可以快一點，結果整個進度反而更慢。
本來以為多兩個人release會比較快，沒想到反而拖得更久。

firstAttempt.answer: 我們本來想說加兩個工程人可以幫我們加速release，結果事情反而全部都慢下來了。

entries.lesson: scale evidence to the size of the claim, predicated with 就; dismiss weak evidence as a category with 這種
entries.targetExpression: 說法越誇張，證據就要越夠力／這種根本不算證據
entries.english: He says this supplement cures insomnia in three days. The bigger the claim, the stronger the evidence has to be — one friend's Facebook post really doesn't count as evidence.
entries.context: To your sister, who's about to buy a health supplement
referenceAnswers: 他說這個保健食品三天就能治好失眠？說法越誇張，證據就要越夠力啊。你朋友在臉書上po一篇，這種根本不算證據。
三天治好失眠喔？主張越大，證據就要越扎實。一個朋友在臉書上講的，這種根本沒什麼說服力啦。

firstAttempt.answer:
她說這個supplement可以讓睡眠不足在三天內就好，說法越誇張，證據就要越紮實，facebook上某一個朋友的po文不太算什麼證據。

I forgot what other words to use for "strong" when referring to evidence.
